Short Description: 743 m² of marble, quartzite, travertine and limestone for a private country residence in Dormans Park, East Grinstead. Ongoing 2026.
Secondary Stones: Dover White; Statuario; Arabescato; Calacatta Michelangelo; Light Beige Vein Cut Travertine; Taj Mahal; Bianco Carrara CD; Jura Beige
Stonework Services: Site measurement and templating, shop drawings, stone selection, cut-to-size fabrication, edge profiling, packing, delivery coordination and on-site supervision for a marble staircase, stone flooring, fireplaces, kitchen surfaces, bathrooms, WCs, bespoke basins, a bar and an indoor pool hall.
Measurement / Templating: Room-by-room site survey and templating, including the curved staircase, followed by shop drawings for every stone element before fabrication.
Fabrication / Cutting: Cut-to-size production from approved shop drawings: curved stair treads and risers, large-format wall slabs, herringbone floor pieces, bath surrounds, vanity tops, fireplace surrounds and moulded counter edges.
Logistics / Delivery: Packed and labelled deliveries sequenced room by room for Dormans Park, East Grinstead, coordinated with site access and the wider fit-out programme.
Installation: On-site supervision of the stone installation across all 743 m², with setting-out against the drawings, vein and joint alignment checks, protection of finished surfaces and snagging.
Sealing / Aftercare: Sealing recommendations, cleaning guidance and maintenance notes for each stone type, issued for handover.

Overview Text: Private Residence Dormans Park is a 743 m² natural stone package for a country house on the Surrey–Sussex border near East Grinstead. The work is ongoing in 2026 and Marla Stone is currently on site. Nine stones are used across the house: Olive Maron, Dover White, Statuario, Arabescato and Calacatta Michelangelo marble, Bianco Carrara CD, Taj Mahal quartzite, Light Beige vein-cut travertine and Jura Beige limestone. The scope runs from a curved marble staircase and the hall and living room floors to fireplaces, kitchen surfaces, bathrooms, WCs, bespoke basins and a basement suite with a bar and an indoor pool.
Featured Stonework Text: The staircase is the centrepiece: curved treads and risers templated on site and drawn piece by piece before cutting, so each tread follows the sweep of the stair. Bathrooms pair large-format veined marble wall slabs with herringbone marble floors, solid bath surrounds, recessed niches and vanity tops cut from the same blocks so the veining reads across walls and joinery. In the basement, the pool hall is lined with bookmatched marble panels and marble-clad columns, with a stone pool surround and a bar counter finished with a moulded edge profile. Every room was issued as shop drawings first, so vein direction, joint lines and edge details were agreed on paper before any slab was cut.
Data Notes: Added Nov 2026. Ongoing 2026, currently on site; update to completed and add final photography at handover.
